answer: In the decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is ensured by a novel mechanism where each agent must deploy a verifiable delay attestation (VDA) at dawn, anchored to a unique reef of cryptographic hash functions, thereby preventing multiple identities.
